chapter: Teddy Wilson, Cafe Society and bebop
title: Rehearsing and working with Fletcher Henderson
summary: He rehearsed a long time with Fletcher Henderson, a carefree man who never reaped the harvest of Goodman's success, before Henderson died.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Now did you work with Fletch, when was that, was that around '41?

Well, that was during the same time yes. I rehearsed with Fletcher with -- for quite a long time, but he didn't -- he didn't -- he was supposed to go into the Savoy, that's when he died. He didn't make it.

Uh-huh. Well Fletcher was a -- a man who would -- you know, had quite a lot of accomplishments, artistic accomplishments, but he never really -- I mean he was largely responsible for the success of the Benny Goodman band --
-- but he never really reaped the harvest of that himself.
No. He was a carefree type of a person, nothing seemed to bother Fletcher at all.
Uh-huh. And, when you were -- you worked with him, you were a member of the band for a little while --
I was a member of the band.
It wasn't just rehearsals, I mean you
Yes, we had a couple of jobs -- we may have played the Savoy once or twice with the band, I don't know, but it didn't last any longer than that.
